plan.purpose: Fixed layer-capacity condensation attribution after near-uniform upper humidity in proportional column rain. Two predeclared profiles; no Earth accuracy claim.
plan.physical_definition: All previous synthetic inputs remain fixed. Partition total saturation capacity using the prior fixed0.2 humidity shape, f_lower=.625/f_upper=.375, but DO NOT force actual humidity. Evaluate unchanged rain_coefficient at equivalent column W_i/f_i; this exactly recovers the original column law when W_i=f_i*W, including convective numerical water floor. Each layer independently condenses/removes water through its own humidity relative to capacity. No new temperature or rain-law parameters. No/5day symmetric mixing separately controlled. Capacity shape is prescribed, not independently observed vertical thermodynamics. Parent controls imported only after verifying all frozen source/record hashes; no new parent climate integrations.
plan.publication: Two manufactured nonlinear solves, no Earth climate integration or normal atlas adoption. Retain all outcomes and strict per-layer residuals. New capacity shape is an explicit approximation; no interpretation as independent cloud temperatures, latent heating or validation. No adaptive profiles after outcomes.
